Private Function Asked(target As Range, member As String) As String
    Dim found As Range
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case member
        Case "Precedents": Set found = target.Precedents
        Case "DirectPrecedents": Set found = target.DirectPrecedents
        Case "Dependents": Set found = target.Dependents
        Case "DirectDependents": Set found = target.DirectDependents
    End Select
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Asked = "E" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
    Else
        Asked = found.Parent.Name & "!" & found.Address & "#" & found.Areas.Count
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function

Private Function Asked(target As Range, member As String) As String
    Dim found As Range
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case member
        Case "Precedents": Set found = target.Precedents
        Case "DirectPrecedents": Set found = target.DirectPrecedents
        Case "Dependents": Set found = target.Dependents
        Case "DirectDependents": Set found = target.DirectDependents
    End Select
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Asked = "E" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
    Else
        Asked = found.Parent.Name & "!" & found.Address & "#" & found.Areas.Count
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function
Public Function Reopened(folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, out As String
